brief: The canvas displays a continuous, generative stream of text that appears as if being typed out automatically by a vintage machine. The typed words cascade onto the surface of aged paper, which serves as the backdrop. As the text streams, the paper visibly reacts to the writing process; the surface around the letters warps subtly and permanently, generating deep, visible creases and ripples that track the entire flow of the text across the visible space.

statement: This sketch creates a vintage typewriter effect on aged paper, where text flows automatically across the screen. As characters appear, they subtly warp and distort the paper surface around them. The visual system tracks each character's position with permanent crease marks that ripple outward, creating a sense of physical interaction between the writing and the paper. The effect uses a combination of particle-based character display and persistent warping to simulate the tactile quality of writing on aged paper, where each word leaves a lasting impression in the surface texture.
